posts.title: I’m moving to Substack
posts.description: I tried to retire as I approached a landmark birthday. (OK, I turned 75.) It didn’t go well. I missed reporting and writing. I had things that I wanted to say–and things I wanted to understand. Working as a reporter for more than half a century has given me a lifelong license to learn. posts.title: America’s epidemic of rudeness
posts.description: When my oldest friend, a baseball historian, visited last summer, we spent a pleasant afternoon at Nationals Park watching my beloved Washington Nationals lose to the Miami Marlins. Pleasant, that is, until we left the ballpark on a packed escalator. Halfway down, a young man threw up on my friend’s leg.
